mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) consistently predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced discount rates on equity cash flows and lower borrowing costs for corporations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate environments are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 0.25%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to compressed equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.25%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Joint deterioration in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and payrolls (PAYEMS) signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings visibility.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, elevated housing starts (HOUST) signal overbuilding and impending slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending momentum.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST is elevated in late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to improved corporate profit outlooks.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in high-industrial-production environments are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 7.5%, it signals economic weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate investment.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Joint acceleration in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to elevated corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both accelerate, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%) signals aggressive rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced equity attractiveness.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5% in a monetary tightening cycle, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
